_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
O cei Player {player_id} ena game Liar's Dice ni {num_players}-player.
Lawatu:
- Ena nomuni turn, o na qai vinakata me:
  1) Me bid e sivia na quantity se face e sivia (se both) na current bid; mena ga na '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Me call na last bid ena type '[Call]'.

Ena o call:
  - Ena actual count ni face value oqo ena all dice e lailai sara ga na bid, na last bidder lose eka die.
  - Na oka, na caller lose eka die.
E dua na player e rawa ni 0 dice e eliminated. Na last remaining player win.

board.new_round:
New round - Remaining dice: {dice_summary}
Oqo na nomuni Dice ni yasa: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Player {current_player_id} calls! The actual count of face {face_value} is {count}, which is LESS than {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (the last bidder) loses one die.
call.caller_loses:
Player {current_player_id} call! Na actual count ni face {face_value} e {count}, ka e >= {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (na caller) lose eka die.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: E sega ni dua e vakaliuliu me volia.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Action e sega ni recognized me vaka e valid '[Bid: X, Y]' se '[Call]'. Submitted action: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Na levu ni iwiliwili vou {new_quantity} e lailai sobu mai na kena sa tu oqo {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: New face value {new_face_value} e lailai sara ga na current {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: E tautauvata na isau ni ilavo e soli tiko.
bid_reason.face_range: Na kena isau e dodonu me 1 ina 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: Player {player_id} a vakawabokotaki ena sega ni dodonu na toso.
